_readme: One entry per project. Pages are rebuilt with: node tools/build.mjs (run in the site folder).
draft: true  -> the project gets its own preview page (case-<id>.html) with prompts for missing parts, but is not linked anywhere, not in the sitemap and hidden from search engines.
draft: false -> the project is published: it appears on the Projects page, on the home page (newest three), in the menu and in the sitemap.
Leave any field empty ("" or []) and it is simply left out of the published page.
sector must be one of: food-beverage, agriculture, construction, energy, life-sciences, hospitality, healthcare.
services can include: roi, advisory, design, construction, electrical, mechanical, commissioning.
figures: the headline numbers, e.g. { "value": "18 months", "label": "payback on the heat-pump upgrade" }. Only use figures the client is happy to publish.
images: paths inside assets/img/. Each .jpg should have a .webp copy beside it. before + after together give a drag slider; card is the photo used on project cards.
